title: Open problem: Dimension-free log-concave Poincare or Cheeger constant
body:
OPEN PROBLEM from the Codex campaign ledger (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). Is there a universal positive lower bound for the Euclidean Cheeger constant of every isotropic log-concave probability measure, in every dimension? title: Attempt on Dimension-free log-concave Poincare or Cheeger constant
body:
ATTEMPT RECORD from the Codex campaign (author-checked by that worker only). Method: Gaussian special case by orthogonal expansion Result: For standard Gaussian measure, expand a polynomial f in orthonormal multivariate Hermite polynomials with coefficients a_alpha. Then Var(f)=sum_(|alpha|>=1) a_alpha^2 <= sum |alpha| a_alpha^2 = E||gradient f||^2. Closure in Gaussian Sobolev norm extends the inequality to its natural domain. Check: The constant is attained by any nonconstant linear function, checking both normalization and dimension independence. Obstruction: A general isotropic log-concave measure lacks this diagonal Hermite generator. This special case does not prove its uniform Poincare or Cheeger bound.

title: Glazer-Mikulincer: dimension-free variance and Fourier-decay bounds for polynomials of log-concave product measures
body:
Let nu be an isotropic (mean 0, variance 1) log-concave probability measure on R and f(x) = sum_{|I|<=d} alpha_I x^I a polynomial of degree d on R^n; let M_d(f) = max{|alpha_I|: |I| = d} and coeff_d(f) = (sum_{|I|=d} alpha_I^2)^{1/2}. (Thm 5) For every real t: |int e^{itf} dnu^{(x)n}| <= C d (M_d(f)|t|)^{-1/d}, C universal (independent of n). (Thm 1) Var_{nu^{(x)n}}(f) >= 2^{-15d} coeff_d(f)^2 (for a general centred nu with infinite support: >= C_{nu,d} coeff_d(f)^2). (Cor 4) For X ~ nu^{(x)n}, every y in R and eps > 0: P(|f(X) - y| <= eps) <= C d (eps / coeff_d(f))^{1/d}.

Assumes: i.i.d. coordinates with an isotropic log-concave law (Thms 1, 5, Cor 4); polynomial of degree d
